title: Single Number
constraints: Each element in the array appears twice except for one element which appears once.
Return the value that has no matching duplicate.

examples.explanation: XOR cancellation applies to signed integers too.

solutionApproaches.title: Frequency Map
solutionApproaches.explanation: Count occurrences and return the value with count one; clear but not constant-space.

solutionApproaches.title: XOR
solutionApproaches.explanation: XOR of a number with itself is 0. XOR all elements — duplicates cancel and the lone value remains.
